---
title: "Horizontal rule uses Typst's native divider"
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      # Pandoc 3.13's typst writer emits #divider() for HorizontalRule; Quarto's
      # template must not shadow divider so it resolves to the native
      # std.divider element (restyleable via show/set rules), matching
      # pandoc's default template with typst >= 0.15.
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        - ['\#divider\(\)']
        - ['\#let divider']
      noErrors: default
---

a

---

b
